name_zh: 马来西亚·马哈蒂尔：发展主义与多元种族治理
description_zh: 马哈蒂尔·莫哈末 (1925-2024) 马来西亚第四/七任首相 (1981-2003, 2018-2020)，推行"向东看"工业化、多媒体超级走廊、双峰塔建设，实施土著优惠政策平衡种族关系，22年执政创造亚洲四小虎奇迹。
description_en: Mahathir Mohamad (1925-2024) Malaysia 4th/7th PM (1981-2003, 2018-2020), implemented Look East industrialization, Multimedia Super Corridor, Petronas Towers, Bumiputera affirmative action balancing racial relations, 22-year rule created Asian Tiger miracle.
reason_zh: 马哈蒂尔代表后殖民多种族国家通过发展主义实现种族平衡与经济腾飞的典范，展示了威权发展主义如何在多元社会中维持稳定与增长，其眼镜标志性形象象征务实理性。
reason_en: Mahathir represents post-colonial multiracial nation achieving racial balance and economic takeoff through developmentalism, demonstrating how authoritarian developmentalism maintains stability and growth in diverse society, his iconic glasses symbolizing pragmatic rationality.
steps_zh: 研究马哈蒂尔早年医生与马来亚大学学生运动
分析1981年上台与向东看工业化战略
探讨土著优惠政策与华商资本合作共生机制
评估1997亚洲金融风暴拒绝IMF方案自主应对
总结1998安华事件与2018年93岁二度上台创纪录
steps_en: Study Mahathir early doctor and UM student activism
Analyze 1981 accession and Look East industrialization strategy
Explore Bumiputera affirmative action and Chinese capital symbiosis mechanism
Evaluate 1997 Asian financial crisis IMF rejection autonomous response
Summarize 1998 Anwar affair and 2018 93-year-old second term record
expected_zh: 掌握马哈蒂尔发展主义与种族平衡双重治理艺术，理解后殖民多元社会经济腾飞与社会稳定的辩证关系，评估其对东南亚发展模式的深远影响。
expected_en: Master Mahathir developmentalism and racial balance dual governance art, understand post-colonial diverse society economic takeoff and social stability dialectic, evaluate its profound impact on Southeast Asian development model.
case_zh: 1981 首相；1982 向东看；1996 双峰塔；1997 拒绝IMF；2003 交权；2018 二度上台；2024 逝世。发展主义多元眼镜长寿范式永存。
case_en: 1981 PM; 1982 Look East; 1996 Petronas Towers; 1997 rejected IMF; 2003 handover; 2018 second term; 2024 death. Developmentalism diversity glasses longevity paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Developmentalism model; racial affirmative action; Asian financial crisis; longevity record
